I have built **Cyber Runner 3D**, a fast-paced sci-fi endless runner game built in WebGL with Three.js.

You can play the live game here:
👉 **[Play Cyber Runner 3D](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/e59bc8bc-72b3-4d63-b290-801a225b4b51/f2b44e3bc512033f5ac68a89/)**

---

### 🎮 Gameplay & Features

1. **Procedural 3D World**:
   - Dynamic 3-lane neon synthwave highway surrounded by low-poly skyscrapers, neon light beams, glowing lane dividers, and a synthwave grid horizon.
   - Smooth continuous track chunk streaming and obstacle generation.

2. **Hero Controls & Mechanics**:
   - **Lane Switching**: Smooth spring-lerp transitions with realistic banking roll (`A` / `D` or `←` / `→` or swipe left/right).
   - **Jump & Double Jump**: Leap over laser hurdles and barriers (`W` / `↑` / `Space` or swipe up). Double jump for aerial control.
   - **Slide & Fast Dive**: Duck under high-voltage laser gates (`S` / `↓` or swipe down). Press down while airborne to dive down immediately.
   - **Launch Ramps**: Speed ramps that launch your hero high into the sky over blockades to collect floating coin arcs.
   - **Moving Drone Hazards**: Security drones that patrol side-to-side between lanes.

3. **Power-Ups**:
   - 🧲 **Coin Magnet**: Vacuums all nearby energy coins directly into your runner.
   - 🛡️ **Energy Shield**: Absorbs obstacle collisions with a crash deflection bubble and temporary invulnerability.
   - ✨ **Score Multiplier**: Doubles/triples score gain.
   - ⚡ **Hyper Jet Boost**: Supersonic rocket thruster blast that renders you invincible and smashes obstacles out of the way.

4. **Procedural Web Audio Engine**:
   - Driving synthwave electronic soundtrack with dynamic tempo scaling that accelerates as your run speed increases.
   - Procedural audio effects for jumps, slides, coin chime streaks, power-ups, and impacts (zero external audio dependencies).

5. **Shop, Customization & Upgrades**:
   - Unlockable cyber-suit chromas: *Cyber Striker*, *Crimson Valkyrie*, *Solar Vanguard*, *Emerald Ghost*, and *Void Phantom*.
   - Persistent upgrades for Magnet Duration, Shield Strength, Multiplier, and Hyper Jet Boost (stored in `localStorage`).

6. **Mobile & Desktop Support**:
   - Touch gestures (swipe left, right, up, down) and on-screen virtual touch controls for phones/tablets.
   - Keyboard controls (`WASD` / Arrow keys / Space / ESC) for desktop.

---

### 📁 Project Files
- [index.html](file:///home/agent/workspace/index.html) - Main game viewport, HUD, menus, and modals
- [css/style.css](file:///home/agent/workspace/css/style.css) - Cyberpunk glassmorphism UI styles
- [js/game.js](file:///home/agent/workspace/js/game.js) - Core game loop, collision detection, and track generation
- [js/models.js](file:///home/agent/workspace/js/models.js) - Procedural 3D hero model, obstacles, ramps, and environment
- [js/audio.js](file:///home/agent/workspace/js/audio.js) - Procedural Web Audio synthesizer and SFX engine

I have upgraded and polished **Cyber Runner 3D** with dynamic biomes, a near-miss dodge mechanic, floating score popups, and mission objectives!

Play the game now:
👉 **[Play Cyber Runner 3D](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/e59bc8bc-72b3-4d63-b290-801a225b4b51/f2b44e3bc512033f5ac68a89/)**

---

### 🌟 New Features & Enhancements

1. **Dynamic Zone / Biome Transitions**:
   - **Zone 1: Neo Tokyo (0–450m)** — Deep neon cyan skyscrapers, atmospheric purple fog, and cyan speed lines.
   - **Zone 2: Outrun Sunset (450–950m)** — Warm retro sunset horizon, crimson fog, and amber hurdles.
   - **Zone 3: Matrix Void (950m+)** — Acid green and obsidian monoliths with high-speed digital pulse grids.
   - Features animated on-screen zone transition banners.

2. **Near-Miss Dodge System**:
   - Switching lanes within split-seconds of an incoming obstacle triggers a **`NEAR MISS! +250`** bonus with slow-mo feedback, particle sparks, and sound.

3. **Floating Arcade Popups**:
   - Real-time animated score and status popups for `DOUBLE JUMP! ⚡`, `RAMP FLIGHT! 🚀`, `SMASH! +150`, `STREAK x15! 🪙`, and `NEAR MISS! +250`.

4. **In-Run Missions & Bounties**:
   - Active missions to earn bonus coins during your run (e.g., reaching distance milestones, gathering coins, landing near-miss dodges).
   - Triumphant audio fanfare and gold toast notifications upon completion.

5. **Audio Preferences & State Persistence**:
   - Audio and SFX toggle states are remembered across sessions via `localStorage`.

---

### 📁 Updated Source Files
- [index.html](file:///home/agent/workspace/index.html) — Floating text popups, zone transition banners, and mission toasts
- [css/style.css](file:///home/agent/workspace/css/style.css) — Keyframe animations for arcade popups, zone banners, and glassmorphic UI
- [js/game.js](file:///home/agent/workspace/js/game.js) — Biome manager, near-miss detector, missions engine, and audio persistence
- [js/models.js](file:///home/agent/workspace/js/models.js) — Procedural rigged hero, obstacles, launch ramps, and skyline
- [js/audio.js](file:///home/agent/workspace/js/audio.js) — Web Audio synthwave BGM, near-miss sweep, and mission fanfares
